capabilities: Fetch comments from any Hacker News post
Customize note filenames with template variables
Configure timestamp format and enhanced username links
extras: Uses the public Hacker News API with HTML parsing as fallback; sanitizes content during conversion to prevent script injection.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture Hacker News discussion threads as readable notes in the vault.
summary: Hacker News scraper that fetches a post's comment thread and saves it as a Markdown note with indentation, metadata, and filename templates.
